title: Repeat while needed

title: Collect matching values
prompt: The input is a list of zeros and ones. Collect its ones in a new list. empty_list() creates a list with no entries; add(list, item) adds an item to that list. Fill the gaps with empty_list, ==, and add.
explanation: == tests each value. add changes result, which can contain repeated entries. An empty input gives an empty result.

title: Record checked pairs

title: Name the parts first
prompt: children_first(tree) visits each child before its parent. record_name keeps a label beside a node. Variables keep their own names; connectives receive fresh ones. Fill the gaps with for, if, and else.
code:
def name_parts(tree):
    ___ node in children_first(tree):
        ___ is_variable(node):
            record_name(node, variable(node))
        ___:
            record_name(node, fresh_variable())
    return name_of(root(tree))
explanation: A connective is named only after its children. This records names but does not yet add Tseytin constraints or require the root to be true.
